messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010: firm 23,400 pc/year commitment for 24 or 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer one. The attached sheets commit 23,400 pc per year for 24 or 36 months at a 42-day lead time.

Our should-cost cost:340010 estimates your unit cost at EUR 24.31 before margin. Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, which makes this a growing and plannable load for your plant. Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows 79.5% on-time delivery, so a firm 42-day lead time matters to us.

Please submit this to your pricing committee for an authorised review. Could you also tell us your earliest lead time and any cheaper seal variants?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010: firm 23,400 pc/year commitment for 24 or 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your should-cost data and volume projections. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Committing to a 42-day lead time over 36 months requires dedicated capacity, which carries a substantial premium.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Our main offer stands at a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Alternatively, we offer a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. We offer €31.90 for 23,400 units over 36 months, provided we maintain our standard 54-day lead time.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
